env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m
! logos build -o $WORK/out$GOEXE ./cmd
stderr 'const_view_mutation'
! exists $WORK/out$GOEXE
! logos build ./...
stderr 'const_view_mutation'
! exists $WORK/out$GOEXE
cd ..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/noemit

go 1.27

-- m/c/c.lgo --
package c

type Namer interface {
	const Name() string
}

-- m/u/u.lgo --
package u

import "example.com/noemit/c"

type Bad struct {
	N int
}

func (m *Bad) Name() string {
	m.N++
	return "bad"
}

var _ c.Namer = &Bad{}

func Msg() string {
	return "hi"
}

-- m/cmd/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/noemit/u"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Println(u.Msg())
}
